name: Sage Linen
tagline: Warm linen background with sage green accents, serif titles, soft rounded cards and a dashed-circle radar chart (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Linen cream with sage green primary and a sand-orange secondary

typography.style: Serif titles and quotes over light sans body, tiny tracked uppercase labels

best_for: Analytical talks that should feel humane and designed, with a radar or card-based comparison. Fits design-studio style research.
avoid_for: High-energy keynotes or dense financial tables.
